items.title: Japan's GMO Offers $1 Million Bounty to Catch Hackers Behind FX Trading Cloud Breach
items.description: Japan's GMO Internet Group is offering up to $1 million in total for tips that help catch the attackers who breached its Onamae.com Desktop Cloud service, after refusing to pay an extortion demand. items.title: Tailscale Patches SSH Flaws That Could Let Hacked Devices Gain Root Access on Other Servers
items.description: Tailscale has released version 1.104.4 to fix flaws in its built-in SSH server that could let an attacker reach services and files on other servers that only the root user should be able to touch. items.title: ShinyHunters-Exploited Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day Turns Out to Be Three Chained Flaws
items.description: The critical Oracle PeopleSoft bug that ShinyHunters has exploited since May is not one flaw but three chained together, the researchers who reported it said this week. Oracle patched all three under a single identifier, CVE-2026-35273, in June. items.title: Third Serengeti Sweep Tops 1,400 Arrests as Investigations Mature
items.description: Interpol's annual Operation Serengeti, now on its third iteration, led to 1,462 arrests across 20 African countries and the US, recovering $105 million in stolen funds.
